items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps report no results; authentication boundaries, least privilege, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release approvals and provenance, dependency/supply-chain controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, TLS coverage, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. TLS reports no certificates expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. Retained worker/reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Risk severity is high for public exposure and security-sensitive release, medium for bounded reversible growth. Exact decision: continue only existing bounded read-only security evidence capture and failed-work containment; maintain private launch gates; permit ordinary reversible growth only when it preserves existing consent, disclosures, data handling, claims, and access boundaries. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, change permissions, deploy, add dependencies, expand exposure, or conduct external outreach.

Continue the existing read-only evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts. Record dated evidence, owners, affected scope, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for access boundaries, secrets, isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data flows, monitoring, incidents, and disclosure readiness. Do not create duplicate telemetry requests or production work.

Continue read-only evidence capture using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record timestamps, owners, scope, unknowns, severity, and release implications. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, change permissions, deploy, add dependencies, or expand public exposure.
